write_script {
    "name": "josephus_problem",
    "code": "
def solve(inputs):
    n = int(inputs['N'])
    j = 0
    powers_2_le_n = 2 ** (len(bin(n)) - 3)
    while powers_2_le_n > 2:
        mask = ((1 << len(bin(powers_2_le_n)) - 3) - 1)
        bits_below_powers_n = j & mask
        j = j >> (len(bin(powers_2_le_n)) - 3)
        j |= bits_below_powers_n + bits_after_k_ones(j, int(inputs['K']))
        powers_2_le_n >>= 1
    return int(j) + 1

def bits_after_k_ones(x):
    x ^= ((1 << (x & -x) - 1))    
    mask = (((-x) & x)) / x
    while (mask != ((mask >> 1))):
        mask |= mask >> 1        
    return mask + 1
@"
}
